data.heading: Model United Nations at DPS Eldeco | Young Diplomats, Global Leaders 🌍
data.content:
Delhi Public School, Eldeco successfully hosted its Model United Nations (MUN) Conference, bringing together 457 delegates from 34 schools for an inspiring experience of diplomacy, debate, leadership, global affairs, and collaborative problem-solving.

The conference was honoured by the presence of Chief Guest Mr. Jayant Krishna, Former Director, AFS India Board, who inspired students to engage with global issues with confidence, curiosity, and responsibility.

Through MUN debates, negotiations, moderated caucuses, and resolution-building, students strengthened their skills in public speaking, research, critical thinking, diplomacy, negotiation, and leadership.

A powerful celebration of young minds, global perspectives, and leadership with purpose. 🌏✨
